barrens_herder_1: Magra Dustwalker. I herd kodo on the plain north of the Crossroads. Strays wander off toward the Sentinel Rocks, just south of here, and what's nesting in those rocks doesn't give them back.
barrens_scout_2: Dorn, plainswatcher. I watch the Kolkar - their outpost is east of this rise and their war camp north-east beyond it. You can see a sandstorm coming an hour out here. A warband gives you less.
groldom_farmer: Kranal Fiss. Grol'dom Farm - my family's held it since before Orgrimmar had proper walls. The quilboar press us from both sides some seasons. The pigs don't care and neither do I.
cb_waterkeeper: Waterkeeper Sanu Goldenhoof. I tend Lushwater Oasis, at your back. Something is choking the springs, and it comes up from the Wailing Caverns - the cave mouth south-west of here.
cb_pools_warden: Torga. I keep watch on the Forgotten Pools, just west of here. Pilgrims came to pray at the water and never went home. They're still in it. Someone should be here to hear them.
cb_caravan_master: Dogan Ironcart, caravan-master. Raider's Rest Oasis, east of my wagons, has water, shade and a fair price on everything. The bandits who've moved in don't care for the third one.
cb_shrine_keeper: Ahnmar Stonetotem. I keep the Shrine of the Fallen Warrior. Quietly, friend. The stone is listening, and so, I think, is the one who fell here.
cb_dreadmist_scout: Zarla Blackthorn, scout. Keep your voice down. The Burning Blade has a den up on Dreadmist Peak, north-west of here, and the cult has ears in the rocks. I'd like to keep the one I have left.
cb_quilboar_ranger: Kishi Plainstalker, ranger. Bramblescar south-west of this road, Agama'gor south-east, Bristleback quilboar in both. It's a pleasant walk to Camp Taurajo, if you like arguing.
cb_bridgewarden: Karga Redfang, bridgewarden. This is the Barrens end of the Southfury crossing - Durotar's on the far bank. Every plank was paid for in blood and bad weather. Mind the snappers in the shallows.
